newsitem.title: USA: Amoco amends Trinidad and Tobago natgas pact.
newsitem.headline: Amoco amends Trinidad and Tobago natgas pact.

text.p: Amoco Trinidad Oil Co reached agreement to supply up to 700 million cubic feet per day of natural gas to the National Gas Co of Trinidad and Tobago Ltd under an amended gas supply contract, the companies said on Thursday.
The pact, which will be formally signed later this month, runs through 2019 and is the largest gas supply contract to date in Trinidad and Tobago, the companies said.
Initial volumes to be delivered to the state-owned company under the pact were not released, and delivery volumes will be phased in as domestic demand rises, an Amoco spokesman said.
Amoco Trinidad Oil Co is a unit of Chicago-based Amoco Corp.
